description: Repos discovered to hold real, ranked latent value. Build-out follows promotion.

repos.thesis: A Lido V3 Vaults audit log that found no critical bug but is a credibility/lead-gen asset wired to a live consult funnel ($2K+ audits), plus a reusable, EV-driven audit methodology (target-selection framework + 7-point pattern checklist + 1M-context cross-file workflow) the estate can templatize to mint more audit artifacts. F3/F4 remain a scoped bounty continuation against Lido's $2M Immunefi ceiling. Reusable estate capability + compounding revenue path, not archival.
repos.first_task: Extract the methodology from AUDIT.md into a reusable, repo-agnostic PLAYBOOK.md (EV target-selection framework + 7-point vulnerability pattern checklist + 1M-context cross-file workflow), converting the one-off log into a repeatable audit-generation engine.
